text:
Mia: quick sync — finalizing the pricing page experiment for tier labels + the interactive calculator. goal: reduce FAQ escalations, improve clarity for metered vs committed, and capture lead intent for AE routing. want to run 2 naming variants + 2 calculator UI behaviors (slider preview vs inline estimate). thoughts? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Josh: love it. for the calculator, can we show an "effective cost per 1M tokens" metric as a secondary line so teams can compare across commits? keeps math simple for buyers.
Elaine: copy ask noted. i’ll draft microcopy for both naming sets: 1) Builder / Team / Enterprise 2) Starter / Growth / Scale. also microcopy for the calculator tooltip explaining tokens -> model inference units. will post samples in a bit. :pencil2:
Arun: telemetry checklist: need events for calc_open, calc_change (with attributes: tier_variant, slider_value, committed_toggle, effective_price), calc_submit (lead form). experiment_id = pricing_tier_v2_2155. set variant field = naming_variant_A/B. i'll add to the analytics backlog. @Mia confirm we want GA + mixpanel?
Mia: yes GA + Mixpanel. make sure calc_submit includes predicted_mrr_bucket and committed_bool.
Josh: small formula draft (for engineers):
```
// effective cost per 1M tokens
const effectivePerM = committed ? (commit_price / commit_tokens) * 1_000_000 : metered_price_per_token * 1_000_000;
```
Show both numbers side-by-side when committed toggle is on.
Elaine: FAQ drafts — two short Q/As i’ll push to the doc: 
Q: What counts as a token?
A: Tokens are the model's input+output units (roughly words). we give an approximate conversion in the tooltip.
Q: How does committed pricing work?
A: Commit buys reserved capacity at a lower per-token rate; unused commit is credited as account balance for future use (no automatic refunds).
Please flag any compliance-y wording.
LegalBot: wording note: avoid phrasing that promises SLA or latency with pricing. suggest replacing "guaranteed" or "locked-in latency" with "typical" or "target". also the second FAQ item — "credited as account balance" is fine but don't imply time-limited refunds.
Sam: inbound routing rules request: if calc_submit predicts >$5k/mo committed or >$8k projected metered, route to AE queue + tag as "high-intent-calc". under $5k, route to inbound SDR nurture. also capture which naming_variant and which FAQ link they clicked.
Mia: good threshold. add an edge-case: if they opt into a webinar during calc flow, tag webinar_signup=true and route to SDR regardless of threshold.
Arun: quick implementation note for experiment: use feature flag pricing_tier_v2 with rollout 0% -> 50% -> 100%. also instrument a secondary metric: FAQ_click_through_rate.
DeployBot: @team scheduled the A/B rollout for 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC in staging and 2026-04-04 02:00 UTC to prod. experiment flag created: pricing_tier_v2_2155. automated rollback on error.
Josh: design ask — can we hide the commit math behind a chevron on mobile to save space? show sticky CTA with estimate and a "compare" link that expands.
Elaine: will design compact + expanded calc states. will deliver assets by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: inbound playbook for CS: if high-intent-calc and no response from AE in 24h, send automated onboarding doc + invite to a weekly pricing webinar. i'll draft the email.
Mia: solid. action items: Elaine = final copy + mobile assets; Arun = telemetry + feature flag; Josh = UX dev spec; Sam = routing playbook + email; LegalBot = final sign-off on copy; DeployBot = schedule confirmed. We'll have a quick go/no-go sync Fri 09:30 PT. thanks everyone — keep threads short here and link to the experiment doc when updating. :rocket:
